name: the crane, and the site coming down
did: Demolition rebuilt. A crane you can climb: ten flights of steel stairs switchbacking up the inside of the tower to a machinery deck at 23 m, an operator's cab, and a jib catwalk you can walk the length of, out over the middle of the map. Six parts of the site now collapse -- each groans and sheds dust for a couple of seconds, drops, kills whoever stayed under it and leaves a heap of rubble. The standing wing is three floors of rooms off a corridor with a door on every one of them, and there is a two-storey site office in the yard.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
